beats.say: Sir Patrick Stewart was knighted in 2010.
He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II for his services to drama.
This honour came after a lifetime of acting, from his Broadway debut in 1971 to his work with the Royal Shakespeare Company.
Fans and colleagues celebrated his legacy, remembering his contributions to theatre and film.
His passing on 28 October 2026 left a void in the hearts of many, echoing the impact of his knighted honour.

facts: Sir Patrick Stewart was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II for his services to drama in 2010, according to Wikipedia.
Sir Patrick Stewart was born on 13 July 1940 in Mirfield in the West Riding of Yorkshire, according to Wikipedia.
Sir Patrick Stewart made his Broadway debut in A Midsummer Night's Dream in 1971, according to Wikipedia.
Sir Patrick Stewart died on 28 October 2026, according to Wikipedia.
Sir Patrick Stewart became a member of the Royal Shakespeare Company in 1966, according to Wikipedia.
